content_of_post_to_answer: Why does my anxiety get worse at night? What is your experience?
answer: Night often removes the distractions that keep anxiety quiet during the day. When the world gets still, the mind finally has room to replay uncertainties, unfinished thoughts, and imagined threats. The problem is not always that anxiety appears at night; sometimes nighttime simply reveals what was being postponed. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. A quiet mind is not always a peaceful mind—sometimes it is just an unoccupied one.
